_comment: Every setting the code reads. tests/test_config.py fails if code and this file disagree. docs/CONFIGURATION.md is generated from it.

settings.name: DATA_BUCKET
settings.purpose: Bucket holding skills, and the ownership file and synthetic evidence when those backends are in use.

settings.name: AGENT_ENABLED
settings.purpose: Operator kill switch. Anything but true refuses every request before identity, data or model.

settings.name: ALLOW_TEST_CLAIMS
settings.purpose: Accept the caller from the request body. Development only.

settings.name: CALLER_CLAIM
settings.purpose: Token claim that identifies the caller. Must be the key used by the ownership source.

settings.name: JWT_ISSUER
settings.purpose: Agent runtime: token issuer to verify against.

settings.name: JWT_AUDIENCE
settings.purpose: Agent runtime: audience the token must carry.

settings.name: JWT_JWKS_URL
settings.purpose: Agent runtime: signing keys location. https only.

settings.name: OWNERSHIP_MAX_AGE_HOURS
settings.purpose: Refuse requests when ownership data is older than this. 0 is off.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_PER_HOUR
settings.purpose: Investigations allowed per caller per clock hour. 0 is off.

settings.name: RATE_LIMIT_TABLE
settings.purpose: Counter table shared by all instances. Empty keeps the count in one process.
settings.production: required when the limit is on

settings.name: EVIDENCE_BACKEND
settings.purpose: file (synthetic), splunk or databricks.

settings.name: SOURCE_HEALTH_CHECK
settings.purpose: Ask each source for an activity count so a silent source is not read as a clean account.

settings.name: EXPECTED_REPORTING_HOSTS
settings.purpose: Domain controllers expected to report. 0 skips the comparison.

settings.name: FIELD_MAP_PATH
settings.purpose: Path to a field map other than config/field_map.json.

settings.name: QUERY_TEMPLATE_DIR
settings.purpose: Path to query templates other than queries/.

settings.name: SPLUNK_BASE_URL
settings.purpose: Splunk management endpoint. https only.

settings.name: SPLUNK_INDEX_WINDOWS
settings.purpose: Index holding directory logon events. Plain identifier.

settings.name: SPLUNK_INDEX_ENTRA
settings.purpose: Index holding cloud sign-in events. Plain identifier.

settings.name: SPLUNK_TOKEN_SECRET_ARN
settings.purpose: Secret holding the read-only Splunk token.

settings.name: SPLUNK_TOKEN
settings.purpose: Plain token. Local runs only.

settings.name: DATABRICKS_HOST
settings.purpose: Workspace URL. https only.

settings.name: DATABRICKS_WAREHOUSE_ID
settings.purpose: SQL warehouse to run statements on.

settings.name: DATABRICKS_VIEW_FAILED_LOGINS
settings.purpose: Three-part view name.

settings.name: DATABRICKS_VIEW_ACCOUNT_EVENTS
settings.purpose: Three-part view name.

settings.name: DATABRICKS_VIEW_ENTRA_FAILURES
settings.purpose: Three-part view name.

settings.name: DATABRICKS_TOKEN_SECRET_ARN
settings.purpose: Secret holding the read-only Databricks token.

settings.name: DATABRICKS_TOKEN
settings.purpose: Plain token. Local runs only.

settings.name: MODEL_ROUTE
settings.purpose: bedrock for a direct call, gateway for a central OpenAI-compatible model gateway.

settings.name: MODEL_ID
settings.purpose: Model or inference profile used for the explanation.

settings.name: ROUTER_MODEL_ID
settings.purpose: Agent runtime: model used only to choose a tool. Defaults to MODEL_ID.

settings.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_URL
settings.purpose: Gateway base URL. https only.
settings.production: required when the route is gateway

settings.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_TOKEN_SECRET_ARN
settings.purpose: Secret holding the gateway token.

settings.name: MODEL_GATEWAY_TOKEN
settings.purpose: Plain token. Local runs only.

settings.name: MODEL_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
settings.purpose: Output token ceiling per model call.

settings.name: MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
settings.purpose: Model call timeout.

settings.name: MODEL_MAX_ATTEMPTS
settings.purpose: Transport attempts for the direct route.

settings.name: GUARDRAIL_ID
settings.purpose: Direct route: guardrail applied to the model call.
settings.production: should be set on the direct route

settings.name: GUARDRAIL_VERSION
settings.purpose: Guardrail version.

settings.name: METRICS_EMF
settings.purpose: Write one embedded metric line per request.
